paper.title: Proximity Search Heuristics for Wind Farm Optimal Layout

public_source.thesis_title: Mixed Integer Programming Models and Algorithms for Wind Farm Layout

paper_problem.decision_variables: binary turbine placement over sampled candidate sites
paper_problem.objective: maximize expected standalone power minus cumulative pairwise Jensen interference
paper_problem.constraints: 3000 m square, 400 m minimum separation, no turbine-count bounds
paper_problem.turbine: Siemens SWT-2.3-93, 93 m rotor and 2.3 MW rated power
paper_problem.wind: 250000+ private real observations clustered to about 500 macro-scenarios
paper_problem.instances: 10 uniform-random instances at each of 1000, 5000, 10000, 15000 and 20000 sites

method.initial_search: parameterized O(n) 1-opt with local cardinality oscillation and 10000 consecutive non-improving calls
method.cleanup_search: parameterized 1-opt with 100 consecutive non-improving calls plus conservative 2-opt
method.reduction: retain incumbent sites and sample unselected sites to at most 2000 total candidates
method.mip: compact Glover interference formulation with soft cutoff and Hamming proximity objective
method.staging: simplified model without interference constraints followed by permanent switch to the complete model
